description: Start a durable Hyperliquid -> Arc home return: one owner-signed withdraw3 to the account's own Arbitrum wallet, then one Arc deposit into the account's verified Arc home Safe. Returns an operation_id immediately. For 5 to 25 USDC prefer arc_home_hypercore_return (direct, no Arbitrum: the route the app uses); this legacy route also needs FELIX_ARBITRUM_RPC_URL set to a private Arbitrum RPC. A refusal moves nothing. Completion means a finalized credit in the Arc home Safe. Reuse the same idempotency_key after any timeout; never start a second return to work around an uncertain one.

accept_amount_adjustment.description: Accept a smaller amount if Felix must keep collateral reserved for open agent positions.

allow_high_fee_loss.description: Accept the proportionally high fixed fees of a return under $10.

amount_usd.description: USDC to withdraw from Hyperliquid (at least 2). The Hyperliquid and Circle fees come out of it.

idempotency_key.description: Required workflow replay key. Reuse it for the exact return.

name: start_arc_home_hl_return
